title: Wazuh Active Response Module Improper Input Validation Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Wazuh. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of IP address arguments. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of JSON messages. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
